summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Echion the Sparti at Thebes and of other bearers of the name in Greek myth.

story.text: Apollodorus names Echion among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Calydoneus and before Lamas in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
